name: Jac Lavoie
caption: Your nervous system isn't broken. It's protesting. 🕊️

slides.text:
This might sound crazy,

but the most rebellious thing you can do right now is stay calm.

A calm mind can't be rushed, scared, or sold to.

If the news, the noise, and the constant urgency leave you exhausted,

that's not weakness.

That's your soul refusing to live at a speed it was never built for.
Just hope the next viral trend is silence, sunlight, real food, deep conversations, and putting your phone down when someone is talking to you.
